cards.oracle_text:

Teleport — {3}{W}: This creature phases out. (Treat it and anything attached to it as though they don't exist until your next turn.)

cards.name: Moment of Heroism
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains lifelink until end of turn. (Damage dealt by the creature also causes its controller to gain that much life.)

cards.name: Guardians' Pledge
cards.oracle_text: White creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Commander Sofia Daguerre
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
Crash Landing — When Commander Sofia Daguerre enters, destroy up to one target legendary permanent. That permanent's controller creates a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")

cards.name: Test of Faith
cards.oracle_text: Prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

cards.name: Answered Prayers
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control enters, you gain 1 life. If this enchantment isn't a creature, it becomes a 3/3 Angel creature with flying in addition to its other types until end of turn.

cards.name: Return Triumphant
cards.oracle_text: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Create a Young Hero Role token attached to it. (Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature attacks, if its toughness is 3 or less, put a +1/+1 counter on it." If you put another Role on the creature later, put this one into the graveyard.)

cards.name: Luminesce
cards.oracle_text: Prevent all damage that black sources and red sources would deal this turn.

cards.name: Fiend Hunter
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, you may exile another target creature.
When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
